title: HR IT Administrator
jobDescription:
HR IT Administrator We offer: The Dormakaba Administrator will be part of the IT Global HR service team. Dormakaba (EXOS and B-COMM HCM) is currently being used in various countries, but has been managed decentrally and only by external partners so far. Dormakaba was recently added to the IT Global HR service portfolio, aiming to centralize management of the system set up and associated business processes, build up internal knowledge, professionalize vendor relationships etc. This role will drive this process and the incorporation into our services application portfolio. The role will also act as the main point of contact for business and IT regarding Dormakaba and will provide key maintenance support going forward. (70%) This role will also act as the Specialist for one other dedicated HR IT system – the specific system is still to be defined. Training will be provided. (30%) Tasks and

QUALIFICATIONS:
Accountabilities: Act as Dormakaba Specialist (70%) Support establishing an international support framework for Dormakaba with clear roles and responsibilities on business, IT and external side – leveraging global and local stakeholders Document the setup of our different Dormakaba instances, identify areas of optimization and harmonization and work with stakeholders to realize these goals Lead the design and delivery of new Dormakaba solutions and changes to existing configurations Act as 1st and 2nd level support for end users Run, maintain and monitor the Dormakaba instances, and complete upgrades as appropriate Support integrations to global and local systems, like Workday and SAP Ensure that solutions are scalable, maintainable, and meet performance requirements Ensure all processes are completed in alignment with Global IT standards and governance. Create and maintain technical documentation, including solution design documents, functional specifications, test plans, and cutover activities according to IT Governance standards Act as Specialist for other HR IT system (30%) Exact system to be defined, e.g. Qualtrics or Walk Me Perform 1st level support activities and participate in system-related projects after training Understand functional requirements and implement these, while following internal IT Governance processes Required core competencies and skill sets: Strong problem solving and analytical skills Excellent communication and intercultural skills that allow smooth collaboration with the business, incl. coordination around system administration, following up on to dos, timelines etc. Business Analyst mindset to understand the internal customer’s requirements and find the best solution for them Ability to work independently and as part of a team Willingness to dive into and learn new systems Experience in working in an international environment Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or with several years of relevant professional experience Approx. 3 years experience in administration or implementation of Dormakaba Qualifications/Specialization: Dormakaba Administration experience English C1 German: B1 or higher KION brands keep the world moving – globally, regionally, and locally. KION is the Supply Chain Solutions Company. With over 42,000 employees in more than 100 countries, we enable smart, sustainable, and reliable supply chains worldwide
- wherever goods are stored, moved, or delivered. KION offers its customers the full spectrum of solutions to make their supply chains future-ready. Our international brands, Linde Material Handling, STILL, and Baoli and our regional brands, Fenwick and OM, stand for outstanding technological innovation, intelligent automation and service excellence in forklift trucks and warehouse equipment. Dematic complements this expertise with state-of-the-art automation technology and AI-supported software solutions that optimize intralogistics across warehousing, production, and distribution. Whether locally or globally – we offer exciting career opportunities in an innovative environment shaped by our core values: Integrity, Collaboration, Courage, and Excellence. Together, we create the magic of supply chain solutions. Join our team – Push it forward.

title: SAP MES/DM Developer
jobDescription:
SAP MES/DM Developer We offer: Main Purpose of the Position – Senior Developer SAP DM To design, develop, implement, and continuously improve SAP Digital Manufacturing (SAP DM) solutions that enable efficient, connected, and data-driven production processes. The position translates manufacturing and business requirements into scalable digital solutions, integrates SAP DM with the broader IT and shop-floor landscape, and ensures reliable system performance and continuous process improvement. Key focus areas include: Developing and enhancing SAP DM applications, extensions, integrations, and APIs. Supporting production execution, operator guidance, resource and order management, traceability, quality, and shop-floor processes. Integrating SAP DM with SAP S/4HANA, SAP PP, SAP ME/MII, automation systems, machines, and other manufacturing applications. Designing scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions aligned with SAP standards and the overall IT architecture. Troubleshooting complex technical issues and ensuring system stability, performance, and data integrity. Collaborating with business, manufacturing, IT, and external partners in global projects. Contributing to testing, documentation, deployment, lifecycle management, and knowledge sharing. Tasks and

QUALIFICATIONS:
You will develop, create, customize and enhance SAP DM/MES objects and provide functional 2nd line production support. You will bring understanding of SAP DM/MES architecture, technical capabilities and limitations and do functional/technical consulting as needed You have experience in advanced business application programming (DM/MES) for SAP Manufacturing You will create system documentation including process representation of your own developments and customizations in Confluence KION brands keep the world moving – globally, regionally, and locally. title: SAP PP Developer
jobDescription:
SAP PP Developer We offer: Main Purpose of the Position To design, develop, implement, and continuously improve SAP Production Planning (PP) solutions that support KION’s manufacturing and supply-chain processes. The position ensures robust, scalable, and integrated SAP functionality by translating business requirements into high-quality technical solutions, collaborating with business and IT stakeholders, and providing expert support throughout the solution lifecycle. Key Focus Areas include: Developing and enhancing SAP PP applications, interfaces, reports, and extensions. Supporting production planning, shop floor, master-data, and related manufacturing processes. Ensuring integration with modules such as MM, SD, QM, CO, and warehouse-management solutions. Driving SAP S/4HANA-compatible and standardized solutions. Troubleshooting complex issues and ensuring system stability and performance. Contributing to global projects, architecture decisions, testing, documentation, and knowledge sharing Tasks and

QUALIFICATIONS:
You will develop, create, customize, enhance and test SAP PP objects and provide functional 2nd line production support.
